pass.answer: When a release PR's required check fails, the monitor re-runs it once with `gh run rerun <run-id> --failed`. On a second failure, the PR receives the `needs-human` label (`gh pr edit <n> --add-label needs-human`) and is never re-run again, because repeated re-runs exhausted the Actions quota on the 3.x line.

A failed required check gets one retry via `gh run rerun --failed`. If it fails a second time, the monitor stops re-running it because repeated re-runs burned through the Actions quota, and labels the PR `needs-human` instead.

First failure: trigger a single failed-jobs re-run with `gh run rerun --failed`. Second failure: do not re-run again (to avoid exhausting the Actions quota) and apply the `needs-human` label to the PR.

fail.answer: Apply the needs-human label to the PR so a maintainer can look at it.
